closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin A, strong vitamin A identity, and cheap and practical, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein amount, low iron, and low vitamin C. It is good for immune support, practical meals, and low-calorie volume because vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
